# PpdsDataReader

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Provider.PpdsDataReader`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

ADO.NET data reader that streams rows from the PPDS query engine. Wraps a list of PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryRow results and exposes them through the standard System.Data.Common.DbDataReader interface.
